title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jakobi Meyers goes for 85 yards in loss
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers caught four of ten targets for 85 yards in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
items.impact: Meyers played second fiddle to Parker Washington in this contest, coming in second in targets, receptions, and yards on the team. It would have been nice to see Lawrence connect with Meyers once or twice more, but it is what it is. He should continue to operate as the WR2 of the team, but expect closer to 6-7 targets rather than the 10 he got on Sunday. He will face off against the Titans next week.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Parker Washington snags eight passes in loss
items.desc: Parker Washington caught 8 of 17 targets for 103 yards in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
items.impact: Washington had a ridiculous 17 targets on Sunday, by far the most he's seen in a game this year. He had a controversial play late in the game where he bobbled a potential touchdown, appeared to secure it and get his feet in bounds, but was ruled incomplete because Washington had not yet completed possession. It's a tough break for the breakout receiver, but he's now had back-to-back 100-yard games and gets the Titans next week.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Bhayshul Tuten held in check on Sunday
items.desc: Bhayshul Tuten ran 10 times for 33 yards and caught all three of his targets for 20 yards in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
items.impact: Tuten was held in check by the Giants' defensive front on Sunday, failing to get much going on the ground and being held out of the end zone. It's disappointing for sure, but the Titans are back on the schedule next week.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Trevor Lawrence throws for 300 yards in loss to Giants
items.desc: Trevor Lawrence completed 25-of-47 passes for 301 yards, a touchdown, and two picks in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
items.impact: Lawrence could have had a much better day, and the game's outcome would have been different had an end-zone throw to Parker Washington been ruled a catch rather than an incompletion. The controversial play saw Washington bobble a pass before appearing to secure it and getting feet in bounds for a touchdown, but it was ruled incomplete. Still, Lawrence had his faults and seemed to succumb to the Giants' pass rush. He will look to have a better outing when he faces the Titans next Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tyler Shough fights consistency issues behind center in Week 11 loss
items.desc: Tyler Shough completed 25-of-42 pass attempts for 222 yards, one touchdown, and one interception while also rushing three times for 34 yards in the Saints' 21-13 Week 11 loss to the Bears.
items.impact: Shough has made up for inconsistent results behind center of late, throwing for one or more touchdowns in each of his last five games. The athletic signal-caller will look for more impactful success against the Cincinnati Bengals in Week 12.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Chris Olave leads pass-catchers in Week 11 loss to Bears
items.desc: Chris Olave hauled in nine of his team-leading 15 targets for 102 yards in the Saints' 21-13 Week 11 loss to the Bears.
items.impact: Olave has made the most of increased volume in the New Orleans offense of late, recording six or more receptions in three of his last four games. The wideout remains the lone reliable option in an inconsistent New Orleans offense to this point, with a Week 12 matchup against the Cincinnati Bengals up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jordyn Tyson bottled up in Week 11 loss
items.desc: Jordan Tyson hauled in one of his two targets for six yards while also rushing once for four yards in the Saints' 21-13 Week 11 loss to the Bears.
items.impact: Tyson has battled inconsistent output in the New Orleans offense since returning from injury, finishing with 30 or less receiving yards in two of his three contests. The rookie pass-catcher remains difficult to trust entering a Week 12 matchup against the Cincinnati Bengals.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Travis Etienne Jr. leads backfield in Week 11 loss to Bears
items.desc: Travis Etienne Jr. carried the ball 14 times for 76 yards while also failing to catch his lone target in the Saints' 21-13 Week 11 loss to the Bears.
items.impact: Etienne Jr. has offered mixed results out of the backfield since returning from injury, rushing for over 70 yards for the first time in two contests. The running back remains one of many risky options in the New Orleans offense ahead of a Week 12 matchup against the Cincinnati Bengals.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Alvin Kamara held in check in Week 11 loss
items.desc: Alvin Kamara rushed once for one yard while also catching one of his two targets for one yard and one touchdown in the Saints' 21-13 loss to the Bears in Week 11.
items.impact: Kamara has made up for an otherwise forgettable stretch out of the New Orleans backfield, recording one or more touchdowns in each of his last two contests. The running back remains difficult to trust as part of an underperforming New Orleans running back group ahead of a Week 12 contest against the Cincinnati Bengals.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Devaughn Vele hauls in seven passes in Week 11 loss to Bears
items.desc: Devaughn Vele hauled in all seven of his targets for 76 yards in the Saints' 21-13 Week 11 loss to the Bears.
items.impact: Vele has offered mixed results in the New Orleans offense of late, posting over 50 receiving yards for the second time in his last four contests. The wideout remains another risky pass-catching option entering a Week 12 contest against the Cincinnati Bengals.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Noah Fant quiet in Week 11
items.desc: Noah Fant caught two of his five targets for 19 yards in the Saints' 21-13 loss to the Bears in Week 11.
items.impact: Fant was one of many disappointing pass-catching options Sunday, finishing under 20 receiving yards in each of his last seven contests. The tight end could be in line for increased snaps if Juwan Johnson (hamstring) misses time, with a Week 12 contest against the Cincinnati Bengals up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Barion Brown sees two touches in Week 11
items.desc: Barion Brown rushed twice for no gain in the Saints' 21-13 loss to the Bears in Week 11.
items.impact: Brown has underwhelmed in the New Orleans offense, recording five receiving yards or less in six of his eight contests. The wideout can remain off rosters in all formats entering a Week 12 contest against the Cincinnati Bengals.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Oscar Delp catches pass in Week 11
items.desc: Oscar Delp caught his only target for six yards in the Saints' 21-13 loss to the Bears in Week 11.
items.impact: Delp has made minimal impact in the New Orleans offense to this point, finishing with less than 10 receiving yards in each of his nine contests. The tight end can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 12 contest against the Cincinnati Bengals.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Bryce Lance sees one target in Week 11
items.desc: Bryce Lance failed to catch his only target in the Saints' 21-13 loss to the Bears in Week 11.
items.impact: Lance has made minimal impact in the New Orleans offense, finishing with less than 15 receiving yards in each of his last nine contests. The wideout can be left off rosters in all formats entering a Week 12 contest against Cincinnati Bengals.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Zay Flowers hauls in eight passes in Week 11 loss
items.desc: Zay Flowers caught 8-of-11 targets for 84 yards in a 35-33 loss to the Panthers.
items.impact: Flowers has quickly built a strong rapport with Jacoby Brissett in his first two starts with the Ravens. Flowers has 14 receptions for 171 yards on 18 targets with Brissett at the helm. Flowers and the Ravens will take on the Texans in Week 12.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: CJ Donaldson sees five touches in Week 11
items.desc: CJ Donaldson rushed one time for five yards while also catching all four of his targets for 12 yards with one fumble lost in the Saints' 21-13 loss to the Bears in Week 11.
items.impact: Donaldson has underwhelmed in the New Orleans offense, finishing with less than 40 offensive yards in each of his eight games. The running back can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 12 contest against the Cincinnati Bengals.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Justin Herbert (concussion) entering NFL concussion protocol
items.desc: Justin Herbert (concussion) is in the NFL's concussion protocol following the Chargers game against the Jets on Sunday.
items.impact: If Herbert were to miss the Chargers next game, which seems likely given most players do, DJ Uiagalelei would be next in line for QB duties. Every Charger skill position player would see a downgrade in fantasy appeal.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Saints D/ST forces two turnovers in Week 11
items.desc: The Saints D/ST forced two turnovers (one fumble recovery, one interception) while also recording two sacks in a 21-13 loss to the Chicago Bears in Week 11.
items.impact: The defense held an explosive Chicago passing attack in check, allowing 165 passing yards in the win. The unit face another difficult test against an explosive Cincinnati Bengals offense in Week 12.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Charlie Smyth misses field goal in Week 11
items.desc: Charlie Smyth converted two of his three field goal attempts while also making his only extra point attempt to finish with seven points in the Saints' 21-13 loss to the Bears in Week 11.
items.impact: Smyth continues a steady stretch, finishing with five or more points in each of his three contests. The kicker will look for another stable performance against the Cincinnati Bengals in Week 12.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Caleb Williams throws two touchdowns in Week 11 win over Saints
items.desc: Caleb Williams completed 15-of-23 pass attempts for 181 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception while also rushing four times for 11 yards in the Bears' 21-13 Week 11 win over the Saints.
items.impact: Williams has been steady behind center of late, throwing for two touchdowns in three of his last four games. The athletic signal-caller will look to offer more dynamic results in a Week 12 Thanksgiving Day matchup against the Detroit Lions.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: D'Andre Swift reaches end zone in Week 11 win over Saints
items.desc: D'Andre Swift carried the ball 13 times for 51 yards while also catching both of his targets for eight yards and one touchdown in the Bears' 21-13 Week 11 win over the Saints.
items.impact: Swift has had a nose for the end zone of late, recording at least one touchdown in five of his last six games. The running back remains a mostly steady backfield option for head coach Ben Johnson entering a Week 12 matchup against the Detroit Lions.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Luther Burden III bottled up in Week 11 win
items.desc: Luther Burden III hauled in two of his three targets for 10 yards while also rushing once for three yards in the Bears' 21-3 Week 11 win over the Saints.
items.impact: Burden III was held in check by the Saints secondary, finishing with under 60 receiving yards for the first time in his last five games. The pass-catcher will look to offer a more impactful performance in a Week 12 matchup against the Detroit Lions.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Mike Evans (Achilles) active for Week 11
items.desc: Mike Evans (Achilles) is officially active for Week 11 for the San Francisco 49ers against the Minnesota Vikings according to Mike Garafolo.
items.impact: Evans is good to go after passing through pregame tests without any issues, offering quarterback Brock Purdy another impactful pass-catching option against an aggressive Minnesota Vikings defense Sunday night.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Colston Loveland finds end zone in Week 11 win over Saints
items.desc: Colston Loveland hauled in all three of his targets for 29 yards and one touchdown in the Bears' 21-13 Week 11 win over the Saints.
items.impact: Loveland has been a reliable target of late, recording over 50 receiving yards in four of his last five games. The tight end will look to provide quarterback Caleb Williams a stable pass-catching option in a Week 12 divisional matchup against the Detroit Lions.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Kyle Monangai quiet in Week 11 win
items.desc: Kyle Monangai rushed eight times for 18 yards while also failing to catch his only target in the Bears' 21-13 Week 11 win over the Saints.
items.impact: Monangai struggled to find much success on the ground, rushing for a paltry 2.3 yards per carry in the win. The running back remains a risky backfield option behind RB1 D'Andre Swift ahead of a Week 12 matchup against the Detroit Lions.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Rome Odunze hauls in four passes in Week 11 win
items.desc: Rome Odunze hauled in each of his four targets for 45 yards in the Bears' 21-13 Week 11 win over the Saints.
items.impact: Odunze has made modest impact in the Chicago passing attack of late, finishing with 45 receiving yards or more in each of his last four games. The wideout remains one of the more reliable pass-catching options in the Bears offense entering a Week 12 matchup against the Detroit Lions.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Kalif Raymond quiet in Week 11
items.desc: Kalif Raymond caught one of his four targets for 14 yards in the Bears' 21-13 win over the Saints in Week 11.
items.impact: Raymond has underwhelmed in the Chicago offense of late, recording less than 35 receiving yards in each of his last seven contests. The speedy wideout remains difficult to trust entering a Week 12 contest against the Detroit Lions.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Zavion Thomas sees three touches in Week 11
items.desc: Zavion Thomas caught two of his three targets for 56 yards while also rushing oncer for 30 yards in the Bears' 21-13 win over the Saints in Week 11.
items.impact: Thomas flashed explosive speed in The Chicago offense Sunday, averaging 28.7 yards per touch in the win. The wideout remains difficult to trust despite his explosive play potential entering a Week 12 contest against the Detroit Lions.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Sam Roush catches pass in Week 11
items.desc: Sam Roush caught his only target for 19 yards in the Bears' 21-13 win over the Saints in Week 11.
items.impact: Roush has been an afterthought in the Chicago offense of late, logging two targets or less in each of his last eight contests. The tight end can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 12 contest against the Detroit Lions.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Salvon Ahmed sees six touches in Week 11
items.desc: Salvon Ahmed rushed six times for 33 yards in the Bears' 21-13 win over the Saints in Week 11.
items.impact: Ahmed flashed explosiveness out of the Chicago backfield, averaging 5.5 yards per carry in the win. The running back remains difficult to trust while normally operating behind the tandem of D'Andre Swift and Kyle Monangai entering a Week 12 contest against the Detroit Lions.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Bears D/ST disruptive in Week 11
items.desc: The Bears D/ST forced two turnovers (one interception, one fumble recovery) while also registering six sacks in a 21-13 win over the Saints in Week 11.
items.impact: The defense wreaked havoc against an underwhelming New Orleans offensive line, allowing less than 190 passing yards in the win. The unit will look for another disruptive performance against an explosive Detroit Lions offense in Week 12.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Cairo Santos misses extra point in Week 11
items.desc: Cairo Santos converted one of his two extra point attempts as well as both of his field goal attempts to finish with seven points in the Bears' 21-13 win over the Saints in Week 11.
items.impact: Santos continues a productive stretch of late, recording seven or more points in each of his last five contests. The kicker will look for another impactful outing in Week 12 against the Detroit Lions.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jahmyr Gibbs rushes for two touchdowns in Week 11 win over Buccaneers
items.desc: Jahmyr Gibbs carried the ball 23 times for 98 yards and two touchdowns while also hauling in four of his five targets for 20 yards in the Lions' 31-21 Week 11 win over the Buccaneers.
items.impact: Gibbs continues a dynamic stretch out of the Detroit backfield, recording one or more touchdowns in nine of 10 games. The running back remains an explosive RB1 option in all formats entering a Week 12 matchup against the Chicago Bears.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jared Goff tosses two touchdowns in Week 11 win over Buccaneers
items.desc: Jared Goff completed 20-of-28 pass attempts for 279 yards and two touchdowns while also rushing five times for 12 yards in the Lions' 31-21 Week 11 win over the Buccaneers.
items.impact: Goff continues a productive stretch behind center, throwing for two or more touchdowns in four of his last six games. The veteran signal caller will for another impactful performance against a tough Chicago Bears defense in Week 12.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown reaches end zone in Week 11 win over Buccaneers
items.desc: Amon-Ra St. Brown hauled in five of his team-leading six targets for 37 yards and one touchdown in the Lions' 31-21 Week 11 win over the Buccaneers.
items.impact: St. Brown made the most of his opportunities on offense Sunday, finishing with five or more receptions for the sixth time in his last seven games. The pass-catcher remains a steady WR1 in all formats entering a Week 12 matchup against the Chicago Bears.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jameson Williams finds end zone in Week 11 win over Buccaneers
items.desc: Jameson Williams hauled in each of his four targets for a team-leading 93 receiving yards and one touchdown in the Lions' 31-21 Week 11 win over the Buccaneers.
items.impact: Williams has had a nose for the end zone of late, recording one or more receiving touchdowns in four of his last six games. The wideout will look to showcase his explosive potential in a tough divisional matchup against the Chicago Bears in Week 12.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Sam LaPorta sees six targets in Week 11 win
items.desc: Sam LaPorta caught three of his team-high six targets for 62 yards in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers in Week 11.
items.impact: LaPorta has struggled to make a consistent impact on offense of late, finishing with over 60 receiving yards for the first time in his last five games. The end will look for another productive performance against the Chicago Bears in Week 12.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Sione Vaki quiet in Week 11
items.desc: Sione Vaki rushed once for a loss of one yard while also catching his only target for seven yards in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers in Week 11.
items.impact: Vaki has made minimal impact out of the Detroit backfield to this point, rushing for less than 30 yards in nine of 10 games. The running back's value remains tied to the health of explosive RB1 Jahmyr Gibbs, with a Week 12 contest against the Chicago Bears up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Isaac TeSlaa sees three targets in Week 11
items.desc: Isaac TeSlaa failed to catch any of his three targets in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers in Week 11.
items.impact: TeSlaa has struggled to make an impact in the Detroit passing attack of late, recording less than 20 receiving yards in each of his last six games. The wideout remains difficult to trust despite flashing explosive potential at times, with a Week 12 contest against the Chicago Bears up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Brock Wright catches two passes in Week 11
items.desc: Brock Wright caught both of his targets for 42 yards in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers in Week 11.
items.impact: Wright has seen minimal involvement in the Detroit offense to this point, recording two targets or less in each of his 10 games. The tight remains little more than an injury handcuff to TE1 Sam LaPorta ahead of a Week 12 contest against the Chicago Bears.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tyler Conklin catches pass in Week 11
items.desc: Tyler Conklin caught his only target for 18 yards in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers in Week 11.
items.impact: Conklin has been an afterthought in the Detroit passing attack to this point, recording one target or less in each of his eight contests. The tight end can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 12 contest against the Chicago Bears.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Lions D/ST records four sacks in Week 11
items.desc: The Lions D/ST recorded four sacks while failing to force any turnovers in a 31-21 win over the Buccaneers in Week 11.
items.impact: The defense made stops when it mattered for head coach Dan Campbell, allowing just 274 offensive yards in the win. The unit faces a stiff test in Week 12 against the Chicago Bears.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jake Bates misses field goal in Week 11
items.desc: Jake Bates converted one of his two field goal attempts as well as all four of his extra point attempts to finish with seven points in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers in Week 11.
items.impact: Bates has been impactful behind a prolific Detroit offense to this point, finishing with seven or more points in nine of 10 contests. The kicker will look for another productive performance against the Chicago Bears in Week 12.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Baker Mayfield tosses two touchdowns in Week 11 loss to Lions
items.desc: Baker Mayfield completed 20-of-33 pass attempts for 187 yards and two touchdowns while also rushing six times for 36 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 Week 11 loss to the Lions.
items.impact: Mayfield delivered a gritty performance while playing through multiple injuries Sunday, recording multiple passing touchdowns for the first time this season. The quarterback will look to take advantage of a generous Carolina Panthers defense in Week 12.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Bucky Irving reaches end zone in Week 11 loss to Lions
items.desc: Bucky Irving carried the ball 18 times for 68 yards and one touchdown while also hauling in three of his four targets for 32 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 Week 11 loss to the Lions.
items.impact: Irving has been impactful out of the Tampa Bay backfield of late, rushing for at least one touchdown and over 60 yards in five of his last six games. The running back remains the lone trustworthy option in an underperforming Buccaneers offense for fantasy managers ahead of a Week 12 matchup against the Carolina Panthers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Emeka Egbuka disappoints in Week 11 loss
items.desc: Emeka Egbuka hauled in just two of his five targets for 18 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 loss to the Lions in Week 11.
items.impact: Egbuka has struggled to make a consistent impact in the Tampa Bay passing attack, finishing under 50 receiving yards in each of his last five games. The wideout remains one of many risky pass-catching options for head coach Todd Bowles ahead of a Week 12 matchup against the Carolina Panthers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Kenny Gainwell sees eight touches in Week 11 loss
items.desc: Kenny Gainwell rushed four times for 16 yards while also catching four of his five targets for 43 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 Week 11 loss to the Lions.
items.impact: Gainwell has offered steady output out of the Tampa Bay backfield of late, recording over 55 offensive yards in each of his last four games. The running back offers more value in PPR formats, with a Week 12 contest against the Carolina Panthers up next.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Panthers D/ST allows 33 points in Week 11 win
items.desc: The Panthers D/ST allowed 276 passing yards, 157 rushing yards, and 33 points in a 35-33 win over the Panthers.
items.impact: The Panthers' defense tallied two sacks, one interception, and three fumble recoveries in the win Sunday. They will have a tough matchup with Tampa Bay in Week 12.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Ryan Fitzgerald perfect in Week 11 win
items.desc: Ryan Fitzgerald connected on 2-of-2 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts in a 35-33 win over the Ravens.
items.impact: Fitzgerald connected on field goals from 33 and 37 yards out to help pace the Panthers to their fifth win of the season. Fitzgerald and the Panthers will take on Tampa Bay in Week 12.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Chris Godwin Jr. quiet in Week 11
items.desc: Chris Godwin Jr. caught all three of his targets for 13 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 loss to the Lions in Week 11.
items.impact: Godwin Jr. continues a disappointing season in the Tampa Bay offense, finishing under 50 receiving yards in all 10 of his contests. The veteran wideout remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 12 contest against the Carolina Panthers.
